package.name: visual_manipulation_tasks
package.description: Task coordinators of the visual-manipulation framework. portafilter_task: vision-guided grasp, transport, alignment (visual servoing), bayonet insertion + locking, verification, unlocking, removal and placement of an espresso portafilter. Robot, camera and simulator independent: everything specific is configuration; only standard ROS 2 / MoveIt 2 interfaces are used.
